department: Faculty 5 - Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology

deadline.value: No application deadline is stated on the faculty doctoral page.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A signed agreement on doctoral studies with the supervisor is part of the application.
supervisor.quote: Then you need to draft and sign an agreement on doctoral studies with your supervisor.

funding.value: Most doctoral candidates at Stuttgart already hold a paid doctoral job; this is a university-wide statement.
funding.quote: Most individual doctoral degree candidates at the University of Stuttgart already have a paid doctoral student job and work as research assistants for the University.

entry_route.value: A master's degree, or a degree of at least four study years, is the entry rule.
entry_route.quote: a) master’s degree studies at a university in the Federal Republic of Germany or | b) degree studies with a standard period of study of at least four study years

notes: The faculty doctoral page covers Computer Science and Electrical Engineering, so ece is listed under also_fields. Independent doctorates need a professor of an institute as mentor.
